ios.desc:
dIM Chat is the offline chat service. Chat with your friends and family on an airplane, under protests and riots or during natural disasters.

* Add contacts by scanning their QR code.
* Chat safely with encrypted messages.
* Works offline by creating a decentralised Bluetooth network.
* Open Source codebase allows developers to verify and trust the app.

show_hn.title: Show HN: Dim – Peer2peer Bluetooth chat app for iOS

quotes.text:
dIM Chat is a peer-2-peer chat app for iOS which works without internet but instead uses Bluetooth.

I was inspired by the Briar project[1] and wondering why there was no such thing for iOS, so I decided to build one. There are still a few things major things which are WiP such as group messaging. The goal of the project is to allow demonstrants to communicate while the mobile data signal is shut off.

Messages are e2ee and the code is Open Source.

Try it out on the App Store[2].

Any feedback is appreciated.

[1]: https://briarproject.org

[2]: https://apps.apple.com/dk/app/dim-chat/id1583606879
